new='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x), (y+1,x), (y,x-1), (y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            y0, y1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            x0, x1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            if y1-y0 < 2 or x1-x0 < 2:
                continue
            border = (all(grid[y0][x] == color and grid[y1][x] == color for x in range(x0,x1+1)) and
                      all(grid[y][x0] == color and grid[y][x1] == color for y in range(y0,y1+1)))
            if not border or not all(grid[y][x] == background for y in range(y0+1,y1) for x in range(x0+1,x1)):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (y1-y0+1) % 2 or (x1-x0+1) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(y0+1,y1):
                for x in range(x0+1,x1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
